about_the_game:
Embark on a Whisker-Twitching Time-Travel Quest!

When a mischievous portal suddenly opens, a curious cat and their bewildered owner are swept away on an extraordinary journey through history! Now, they must explore ancient civilizations, uncover hidden cats, and piece together clues to find their way back home.

Explore Legendary Eras:
Travel through Mesopotamia, Ancient Egypt, Ancient Greece, the Roman Empire, the Viking Age, the Middle Ages, and the Golden Age of Pirates—each beautifully recreated with immersive visuals and playful historical details.

Find Cats of All Kinds:

  • Friendly Cats – Happy to be found, these kitties offer fun facts about their time period.

  • Shy Cats – Masters of disguise, they hide cleverly but leave behind paw prints, knocked-over objects, or flickering tails.

  • Historian Cats – Rare and wise, these special felines share fascinating knowledge about their era, unlocking entries in your Cat Encyclopedia.

Two Exciting Game Modes:

  • Story Mode – A relaxed adventure where you explore each era, uncover secrets, and meet quirky historical characters.

  • Arcade Mode – A fast-paced challenge! Race against the clock to find all the hidden cats and climb the leaderboards.

Collect, Learn, and Unlock:

  • Fill your Cat Collection with adorable felines from across time.

  • Discover hidden artifacts and unlock bonus mini-games (like deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs or navigating a Viking ship!).

  • Upgrade your tools with a cat whistle or time compass to make finding shy cats easier.

A Purr-fect Blend of Fun & Learning:
With its charming art style, humorous dialogue, and lighthearted take on history, Cats Visiting Historical Times is a delightful adventure for cat lovers, history buffs, and gamers of all ages. Will you help these time-traveling companions make it home—or will you stay forever lost in history?

Minimum:

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Good One
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: A cat & owner are lost in time! Journey through ancient Egypt, Viking ships & pirate coves to find hidden cats—some helpful, some sneaky. Collect clues, unlock history, & race the clock in this charming adventure!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
